description: For the card only. Says the person's own words at your resident's door, as they typed them in the card's field, the same as saying them on your home's page. With folded, it's a note on the door that only your resident and the person read. It needs the short-lived token the card was given; without it, nothing is said.

card.description: The card's token, as the card was given it.

folded.description: Optional: true leaves them as a note on the door that only your resident and the person read.

text.description: The person's words, as they typed them.

name: door_line
title: Say at the door
